description: Rent and Sales Report - Interactive Dashboard, NSW is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by NSW Department of Communities and Justice (DCJ). An interactive dashboard showing NSW rent and property sales, created by the NSW Department of Communities and Justice (DCJ). Quarterly rental and sales data is available via an interactive dashboard for Local Government Areas (LGAs) and for LGAs and Postcodes as downloadable tables in Excel (XLSX) format. Coverage is the states and territories, 2017 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as quarterly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-10-27. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
